Recognise 1971 genocide
2023-10-08T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Dinajpur
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/recognise-1971-genocide-3437331

People from all walks of life in Dinajpur formed a human chain yesterday, urging the United Nations to officially recognise the genocide committed by Pakistani forces during the nine-month Liberation War in 1971.

The event was organised by "Aamra Ekattor" in front of Dinajpur Press Club.

The speakers expressed disappointment that the UN has not officially recognised the genocide. They were also concerned about the limited attention the UN has given to this genocide, which they found inconsistent with the UN's core values.

Cultural activists, including Tarequzzaman Tareq and freedom fighters Forhad Hossain, and Bidhan Dutta spoke at the event.
